LOAN / OVERDRAFT / CREDIT CARD AGAINST DEPOSIT Purpose: Avail instant liquidity against your existing Fixed Deposit without breaking it — your deposit continues to earn interest. Variants: 1. Demand Loan against FD 2. Overdraft (OD) against FD 3. Credit Card against FD (secured credit card) Eligibility: - Holders of FD/Term Deposit/MMD/RD with Indian Bank - Both resident and NRI deposits (conditions apply for NRE deposits) - Joint deposit holders — with consent of all holders Loan Amount: - Up to 90% of deposit value - Minimum: Rs.5,000 Interest Rate: - 1% to 2% above the deposit interest rate - Very competitive since deposit continues to earn Repayment: - Loan: Bullet repayment at deposit maturity - OD: Renewable annually - Interest can be serviced monthly Security: - The FD itself is the collateral (lien marked on deposit) - No additional security required Key Benefit: - No need to break FD and lose interest - Instant sanction — same day processing - No income proof required - No credit score check required Helpline: 1800 1700

text: IB EDUCATION LOAN Interest Rate: - Education Loan (general): 7.05%-10.15% p.a., depending on loan amount and applicant profile — the lowest published rate among Indian Bank's education loan schemes. - PM Vidyalaxmi Scheme: 7.25%-8.45% p.a. (government scheme, linked to institute category). - IB SKILL Loan (vocational/skill courses): 9.45% p.a. flat. - Rates are linked to RLLR (Repo-Linked Lending Rate) — floating, so the above ranges move with RBI's repo rate over the loan's life. - Interest subsidy schemes available for eligible students. Purpose: Finance higher education in India and abroad — covers tuition fees, hostel charges, books, equipment, travel expenses for studies abroad. Target Group: - Indian nationals who have secured admission to recognised institutions - Courses covered: Graduate, Post-graduate, Professional (engineering, medical, MBA, law, CA, etc.) - Both Indian and overseas institutions covered Eligibility: - Student must be an Indian national - Admission to recognised institution through merit/entrance test - Co-borrower: Parent or guardian mandatory Loan Amount: - Studies in India: up to Rs.10 lakh (higher amounts based on merit) - Studies abroad: up to Rs.20 lakh (higher amounts available) - Premier institution list: higher quantum available Repayment: - Moratorium: Course period + 1 year (or 6 months after getting job, whichever is earlier) - Repayment: up to 15 years after moratorium Collateral: - Up to Rs.7.5 lakh: No collateral (parents as co-borrower) - Above Rs.7.5 lakh: Tangible collateral required Government Schemes Linked: - Dr. Ambedkar Central Sector Scheme (interest subsidy for OBC/EBC) - Padho Pardesh scheme (for minority students abroad) Online Apply: apps.indianbank.bank.in/ibapps/index.html Helpline: 1800 1700

text: IB HOME LOAN Interest Rate: - IB Home Loan / IB Home Loan (NRI): 7.15%-8.55% p.a. — the lowest published rate among Indian Bank's home loan family. - Home Loan to Corporate Entity: 7.60%-9.10% p.a. - IB Home Loan Plus: 7.65%-8.75% p.a. - IB Home Loan (CRE): 7.65%-9.05% p.a. - Home Loan for EWS, LIG & MIG Individuals (Urban Areas): 7.75%-9.15% p.a. - Plot Loan / Plot Loan (NRI): 8.15%-9.55% p.a. - IB Home Improve: 8.15%-9.55% p.a. - IB Home Enrich: 8.15%-8.70% p.a. - Rates are linked to RLLR (Repo Linked Lending Rate) — floating; a Fixed ROI option is also available under Fixed ROI for Retail Loans. Purpose: Purchase or construction of house/flat, purchase of plot and construction thereon, renovation/repair/extension of existing house. Target Group: - Salaried class employees (Govt, PSU, reputed private companies) - Professionals, self-employed, businessmen - NRIs (separate NRI Home Loan product available) - Corporate entities (separate product available) Eligibility: - Resident individuals with regular source of income - Minimum age: 18 years; Maximum age: 70 years at loan maturity - Joint applicants permitted; co-obligant income can be clubbed Loan Amount: - No upper ceiling — based on repayment capacity and property value - Rural/Semi-urban areas: special consideration - Maximum LTV ratio: 75% to 90% depending on loan amount Repayment: - Maximum tenure: 30 years (including moratorium) - EMI-based repayment - Moratorium period: up to 18–36 months during construction Special Schemes under Home Loan: 1. IB Plot Loan — for purchase of residential plot 2. NRI Home Loan — for Non-Resident Indians 3. NRI Plot Loan — for NRIs buying residential plots 4. Home Loan to Corporate Entity — for companies/LLPs/firms 5. IB Home Loan Flexi — for existing and prospective home loan customers 6. IB Home Improve — renovation/repair for existing home loan borrowers 7. IB Home Enrich — for individuals owning residential property 8. Home Loan for EWS/LIG/MIG — for economically weaker sections 9. PMAY Urban 2.0 (ISS) — interest subsidy scheme for eligible borrowers Security: - Equitable/registered mortgage of the property being financed Processing Fee: - As per bank's schedule of charges (visit indianbank.bank.in/service-charges-forex-rates/) Online Apply: - dlp.indianbank.bank.in/loanPortalHL/ Helpline: 1800 1700

IB JEWEL LOAN Purpose: Instant loan against pledge of gold jewellery/ornaments for any personal or business financial need. Target Group: - Resident individuals - Agriculturists (separate agricultural jewel loan product) - Business owners needing quick working capital Eligibility: - Any resident individual owning gold jewellery - Minimum age: 18 years - KYC compliance mandatory Loan Amount: - Based on gold weight, purity, and prevailing RBI-prescribed LTV ratio - LTV: up to 75% of gold value (as per RBI guidelines) - Minimum: Rs.5,000; Maximum: as per bank norms Types: - Demand Loan (lump sum with bullet repayment) - Overdraft (flexible withdrawal within limit) - Agricultural Jewel Loan (for farming purposes — lower rate) Repayment: - Demand Loan: 12 months (renewable) - OD: Annual renewal - Interest can be paid monthly/quarterly or on maturity Interest Rate: - Competitive rate linked to bank's base rate - Agricultural purpose: lower concessional rate Security: - Gold jewellery pledged with bank (minimum 18 carat purity) - Bank assays and values the jewellery at time of pledge Online Appointment: - Book jewel loan appointment online at indianbank.bank.in - Walk-in also accepted at all branches Helpline: 1800 1700

MORTGAGE LOAN — LOAN AGAINST PROPERTY Purpose: Multipurpose loan against mortgage of owned residential or commercial property for business expansion, working capital, medical emergencies, marriage, education, or any personal need. Target Group: - Resident individuals owning property - Business entities owning commercial/residential property - Professionals Eligibility: - Clear and marketable title of property - Property in applicant's name or close family member - Stable income — salaried or self-employed Loan Amount: - Up to 60%–70% of property market value (LTV ratio) - Higher amounts for commercial properties with strong income Repayment: - Up to 15 years — EMI based - Overdraft facility also available Interest Rate: - Linked to RLLR — floating rate - Fixed ROI option available Security: - Equitable/registered mortgage of property - Legal and valuation reports mandatory Documents Required: - Title deeds, sale deed, encumbrance certificate - Property tax receipts - Income proof - KYC documents - Building plan approval (if applicable) Helpline: 1800 1700

MSME LOANS — MICRO, SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISES Purpose: Working capital and term loan financing for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises across manufacturing and service sectors. Target Group: - Micro enterprises (investment up to Rs.1 Cr, turnover up to Rs.5 Cr) - Small enterprises (investment up to Rs.10 Cr, turnover up to Rs.50 Cr) - Medium enterprises (investment up to Rs.50 Cr, turnover up to Rs.250 Cr) Products Available: 1. Working Capital — Cash Credit / Overdraft 2. Term Loan for plant, machinery, equipment 3. Letter of Credit (LC) for trade 4. Bank Guarantee 5. MUDRA Loans (under PMMY): Shishu (up to Rs.50,000), Kishore (Rs.50,000–5L), Tarun (Rs.5L–10L) 6. Stand-Up India scheme (for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs) 7. 59 Minutes Loan — in-principle approval within 59 minutes In-Principle Approval in 59 Minutes: - Visit psbloansin59minutes.com/indianbank - For loans up to Rs.5 Crore - GST, IT returns, bank statement analysis done digitally Turnaround Time (TAT): - Published on bank website as per RBI guidelines Documents Required: - Business registration / MSME Udyam certificate - GST returns, ITR for last 2–3 years - Bank statements (12 months) - Project report for term loans - KYC of proprietor/partners/directors Helpline: 1800 1700

IB PERSONAL LOAN Purpose: Any legitimate personal financial need — medical emergencies, travel, marriage, home furnishing, consumer durables, education expenses not covered by education loan, etc. Target Group: - Permanent salaried employees of Central/State Govt, PSUs, reputed companies - Professionals with established practice - Pensioners drawing pension through Indian Bank Eligibility: - Minimum net monthly salary / income as per bank norms - Satisfactory credit score (CIBIL) - Existing relationship with bank preferred Loan Amount: - Based on income and repayment capacity - Typically up to 20–24 times net monthly salary - Maximum amount as per bank's current guidelines Repayment: - Up to 60 months (5 years) — EMI based - Pensioners: repayment linked to pension credit Interest Rate: - Linked to RLLR — floating - Fixed ROI option also available Security: - Clean (unsecured) loan — no collateral for most variants - Guarantee of spouse or third party may be required Documents Required: - Latest salary slips (3 months) - Form 16 / ITR - Bank statements (6 months) - KYC documents - Employee ID / service certificate Online Apply: apps.indianbank.bank.in/ibapps/index.html Helpline: 1800 1700

PM SURYA GHAR: MUFT BIJLI YOJANA — SOLAR ROOFTOP LOAN Purpose: Loan for installation of rooftop solar panels under the Central Government's PM Surya Ghar scheme — to help households generate their own electricity and receive up to 300 units free per month. Target Group: - Residential households planning rooftop solar installation - All income groups eligible Eligibility: - Indian resident individual - Own residential property - Property suitable for solar panel installation Loan Amount: - Based on installation cost and subsidy - Central subsidy: Rs.30,000 per kW up to 2 kW; Rs.18,000/kW for 2–3 kW Repayment: - Up to 10 years Interest Rate: - Concessional rate as per scheme guidelines Subsidy: - Direct subsidy credited to bank account by Government of India - Net loan = Installation cost minus subsidy amount How to Apply: - Register on pmsuryaghar.gov.in portal - Choose empanelled vendor - Apply for loan at Indian Bank branch or online Helpline: 1800 1700

text: IB VEHICLE LOAN Interest Rate: - IB Vehicle Loan (new car): 7.55%-8.85% p.a. - IB Vehicle Loan (Eco Vahan, electric vehicles): 7.50%-8.75% p.a. — the lowest published rate among Indian Bank's vehicle loan schemes. - IB Vehicle Loan (Used Car): 9.55%-11.65% p.a. - 2-Wheeler: 8.90%-10.40% p.a. - Van/Minibus/Bus/Ambulance (institutional): 8.75%-9.40% p.a. - Rates are linked to RLLR (Repo-Linked Lending Rate) — floating, so the above ranges move with RBI's repo rate over the loan's life. A fixed ROI option is also available. Purpose: Purchase of new or used vehicles — two-wheelers, four-wheelers (cars/SUVs), and commercial vehicles. Target Group: - Salaried individuals - Professionals and self-employed - Businessmen with regular income Eligibility: - Resident individuals with stable income - Minimum age: 21 years - Both new and used vehicles covered Loan Amount: - New vehicles: up to 85%–90% of on-road price - Used vehicles: based on valuation report and age of vehicle Repayment: - New cars: up to 84 months (7 years) - Two-wheelers: up to 60 months (5 years) - Used vehicles: shorter tenure based on vehicle age Security: - Hypothecation of the vehicle purchased Documents Required: - Income proof (salary slips / ITR) - KYC documents - Vehicle quotation / proforma invoice - Bank statements (last 6 months) Online Apply: apps.indianbank.bank.in/ibapps/index.html Helpline: 1800 1700
